blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Mikey Williams delivered the dagger blows that cemented Converge’s place in the semifinals of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup while also evoking memories of previous playoff moments. His back-to-back threes with three minutes left enabled the FiberXers to create separation from the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters and secure a 120-109 win in Game 4 of their quarterfinal series on Friday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. “I just stayed ready,” Williams said after finishing with 17 points, seven rebounds and three assists as Converge won the best-of-five series, 3-1.
